callouts.title: Complete this entire section BEFORE you begin reading.
callouts.body: Time investment: 5–10 minutes. This is not optional overhead — it is the structural mechanism that makes the reading session productive. See [[Zimmerman's-Cyclical-SRL-Model]] and [[Forethought-Phase]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Activate relevant [[Prior-Knowledge-Activation|prior knowledge]] and existing schema before encountering new material. This reduces [[Cognitive-Load-Theory|cognitive load]] and creates explicit baselines for later calibration. See [[Advance-Organizers]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Accurately assess what this reading task demands so that goal-setting and strategy selection are appropriately calibrated. See [[Strategic-Planning]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Set specific, mastery-framed goals using the three-part structure that activates attentional direction, provides evaluable standards, and sustains [[Intrinsic-Motivation]]. See [[Achievement-Goal-Theory]] and [[Goal-Setting-Theory]].

callouts.title: Process goals are what you actually DO, not what you hope to understand. They should be specific enough that you can definitively say Yes or No to whether you executed them. See [[Deliberate-Practice]].
Purpose
callouts.body: Generate an *accurately calibrated* confidence estimate — not high confidence, but honest confidence. The target is [[Metacognitive-Calibration|calibration]], not elevation. See [[Self-Efficacy]] and [[The-Fluency-Illusion]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Activate [[Self-Determination-Theory|autonomous motivation]] by connecting to genuine interest and [[Autonomy-Support|autonomy-supportive]] framing. See [[Intrinsic-Motivation]].

callouts.title: Forethought Phase Complete
callouts.body:
You are now ready to begin reading. Open the text and execute your process goals.
**Remember:** Flag confusion rather than explaining it away. That data is the raw material for Self-Reflection.

callouts.title: Complete within 30 minutes of finishing the reading session.
callouts.body: Time investment: 10–15 minutes. This is the generative engine of the SRL cycle — where [[Adaptive-Inference|adaptive inferences]] are produced that improve the next session. See [[Self-Reflection-Phase]].

callouts.title: Do NOT consult any notes or the text for this zone.
callouts.body: Write from memory only. Set a 5-minute timer. This is the mechanism that defeats the [[The-Fluency-Illusion|fluency illusion]] — if you can't produce it, you didn't learn it. See [[Retrieval-Practice]] and [[Testing-Effect-Retrieval-Practice-Effect]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Evaluate each process goal against behavioral evidence, not impressions. This is [[Formative-Assessment|formative self-assessment]] — descriptive, not evaluative. See [[Self-Evaluation]].

callouts.title: CRITICAL ZONE — This is the hinge on which the entire cycle turns.
callouts.body: The attribution you generate here determines whether the next session improves or stagnates. See [[Attribution-Theory]], [[Bernard-Weiner]], and [[Attribution-Retraining]].

callouts.title: Before generating ANY global conclusion about your ability or the text's difficulty, complete the strategy-level search below.
Attribution Safety Check
callouts.body: If your natural attribution is "this material is too difficult for me" or "I'm not good at this type of content" — these are global, stable, internal attributions. Before accepting them, you MUST list at least two specific strategy-level explanations you could test in the next session. See [[Mastery-Oriented-Response-Pattern]] and [[Growth-Mindset]].

callouts.title: Purpose
callouts.body: Generate specific, actionable strategy adjustments that feed directly into the next Forethought Phase. This is where the cycle closes. See [[Adaptive-Inference]] and [[Defensive-Inference]].

callouts.title: THE HANDOFF MECHANISM
callouts.body: This is the physical link that ensures the SRL cycle actually closes. Copy this content to the Handoff field of your next session's Forethought Protocol, and update your [[SRL-Living-Learning-Agenda]].

callouts.title: Use mastery grammar to close productively. See [[Achievement-Goal-Theory]].
Session Complete

2. Update [[SRL-Living-Learning-Agenda]] with carry-forward items
3. Create any permanent notes flagged in Zone 5
4. Schedule next reading session
